name: Sitemap Manager
author: michaelgrover

sections.description:
Sitemap Manager gives you full control over your WordPress XML sitemap. Easily exclude thank-you pages, landing pages, or other URLs you don’t want indexed.

Works with Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and the native WordPress sitemap.

Highlights
– See your sitemap in a readable table.
– Exclude any post, page, or custom post type.
– Compatible with major SEO plugins and core sitemaps.
– No impact on content—just the sitemap.

Perfect for advanced SEO, content strategy, and hybrid sites.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sitemap-manager folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Go to Tools → Sitemap Manager to manage your sitemap.
sections.faq:
Can I use this with Yoast or other SEO plugins?

Yes. Sitemap Manager works with Yoast, Rank Math, and AIOSEO. It also supports the native WordPress sitemap if no SEO plugin is installed.

What does Sitemap Manager do?

It lets you exclude specific posts or pages (like thank-you or campaign pages) from the XML sitemap so search engines don’t index them.

Can I add URLs that aren’t part of WordPress?

Yes, in Sitemap Manager Pro you can add any valid URL on your domain (static HTML, PHP, etc.) and we’ll include them in a dedicated sitemap.

How do I exclude a post or page?

Go to Tools → Sitemap Manager → Sitemap, check the box next to any item you want to exclude, and click Save Changes.

I switched SEO plugins. Will this still work?

Yes. Sitemap Manager automatically detects the active SEO plugin and adapts.

Is there a limit to how many URLs I can manage?

No. Manage as many as your sitemap contains.

Where can I learn more about Pro?

Visit Sitemap Manager Pro.
